bio: Just a stone’s throw from one of the most beautiful beaches in the region, this restaurant serves fresh fish, scampi and shellfish caught that very day and prepared in simple, traditional dishes that allow the full flavour of the fish and seafood to shine through (dishes are announced at your table). In summer, don’t miss the relaxing and sunny panoramic terrace. The Jurdan family have been running this restaurant since 1996 – almost thirty years of enthusiastic and reliable service....
